title: Mary Queen of Scots to the Duke of Norfolk, 'the 20th' [Feb or Mar 1570], BL Cotton MS Caligula C II f. 74r

documents.shelfmark: BL Cotton MS Caligula C II f. 74r

plaintext.source: Tomokiyo's partial letter-by-letter overlay (cryptiana mary.htm, image and HTML comment)

transcription.source: BL IIIF images stitched from 1024-px tiles (bl.digirati.io), 23 line strips
transcription.notes: No symbol transcription file in the folder; the reading was made on the strips. 23 lines.

system.summary: Symbol alphabet (one sign per letter, f with two forms) with seven nulls and a word-sign nomenclator for common words and names.
system.sibling_key: Tomokiyo's key rebuilt from the deciphered Norfolk letters ff. 66/69/75; checked on f. 66r against its decipherment and used.

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: BL IIIF manifest found via searcharchives; 1024-px tiles stitched to full resolution.
Tomokiyo's key checked on f. 66r against its contemporary decipherment.
Key applied to 23 line strips; all lines read, five nomenclator signs and a few groups open.
Content dated after Moray's murder (Jan 1570): Morton rumour, Lord Talbot, Elizabeth's blame.

Novelty re-examined. G. Lasry (21 Sept 2026): on cryptiana 'undeciphered' means no interlinear or nearby deciphered copy, not unsolved; unsolved material is on the unsolved page. The key was available (Tomokiyo); the contribution is the transcription and the reading.

outcome.method_basis: Tomokiyo's key for the Mary-Norfolk series, reconstructed from ff. 66/69/75 of the same volume (Cotton Caligula C II) and published on cryptiana mary.htm with a partial overlay of f. 74r, was checked on f. 66r against its decipherment and applied to 23 line strips from the new BL IIIF images.
outcome.notes: Open: five unkeyed signs, two groups in line 1, stained end of line 4, single words.
